name: HF-C104

summary.en: Conventional fire-alarm panel reference for a zoned building system. Confirm the exact regional model and revision before specifying detectors and sounders.
summary.sw: Rejea ya paneli ya conventional kwa mfumo wa jengo wenye kanda. Hakiki modeli na toleo la eneo kabla ya kuchagua vitambuzi na ving’ora.

availability: Confirm revision, sourcing and lead time in quotation

compatibility.en: Do not infer the zone count or approved device list from the brochure family notation. Obtain the exact HF-C104 regional manual, power requirements, zone loading and end-of-line/sounder instructions. This is not an ASENWARE addressable panel.
compatibility.sw: Usihitimishe idadi ya kanda au orodha ya vifaa kwa maandishi ya familia ya brosha. Pata mwongozo wa HF-C104 husika, mahitaji ya umeme, mzigo wa kanda na maelekezo ya mwisho wa laini/ving’ora. Si paneli ya addressable ya ASENWARE.

name: AW-D301
generation: Manufacturer reference / exact revision to confirm

summary.en: Addressable photoelectric smoke detection for suitable indoor conditions, with an individual device address in a compatible AW-FP300 system.
summary.sw: Kitambuzi cha moshi cha photoelectric addressable kwa mazingira yanayofaa ya ndani, chenye anwani yake katika mfumo unaooana wa AW-FP300.

availability: Confirm revision, sourcing and lead time in quotation

compatibility.en: Not for routine dust, steam, oil mist or persistent normal smoke. Assess the room and manufacturer environmental limits; choose another appropriate detection approach where needed. Do not mix panel protocols.
compatibility.sw: Si kwa vumbi, mvuke, ukungu wa mafuta au moshi wa kawaida unaoendelea. Tathmini chumba na mipaka ya mazingira ya mtengenezaji; chagua njia nyingine inayofaa inapohitajika. Usichanganye protocol za paneli.
